chants.vernacular_text: Be unto me a protecting God and a house of refuge, to save me; for you are my support and my refuge; and for the sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me. ℣. In you O Lord, do I trust; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.
You alone are the God who works wonders; you manifested your strength among the nations. ℣. With your arm you delivered your people, the sons of Israel and Joseph.
Sing to the Lord a new song; for the Lord has accomplished wondrous deeds.
Blessed are you, O Lord, teach me your commandments. O Lord, you are blessed, teach me your commandments. With my lips have I declared all the judgments spoken by your mouth.
They ate and were fully satisfied; the Lord gave them all that they desired; they were not deprived of their wants.
